verdict.rationale: Brex documents an official MCP server at developer.brex.com/docs/mcp. It lets AI assistants interact directly with a Brex account (expenses, users, cards, banking transactions, bills) through natural language, and the probe independently confirms the documentation page exists. missing for 10: documented connection/auth setup details (transport, supported clients, permission scoping), independent or hands-on corroboration of the server in use.
